title: 第114章 闻仲降临
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“那为什么，就不能有第二份呢？”

“阐教和天庭能搞一个封神榜。”

“我长青仙宗，自然也能重炼一个。”

顾长青这句话说得云淡风轻，就像是在说“今天晚饭吃米饭还是吃面条”一样随意。

但听在旁人耳中，却不亚于混沌初开时划破鸿蒙的第一声惊雷，震得人心神俱裂，道心震颤！

嬴政，这位扫六合、定八荒，泰山崩于前而色不变的千古一帝，此刻瞳孔骤然骤缩，漆黑的眸中翻涌着极致的震撼，脸上血色微滞，满是难以置信。

重炼……

封神榜？

开什么惊天玩笑！

三界众生，无人不知封神榜的分量！

那是鸿钧道祖亲传天道至宝，是封神大劫落幕之后，诸天圣人共定三界秩序的核心法器，执掌三百六十五位周天正神，定风雨、司山川、掌轮回、稳乾坤，是世间天道规则最具象、最核心的体现！

此物早已与天道绑定，浑然天成，亘古不灭。

莫说重炼再造，寻常大罗金仙连触碰其一丝道韵的资格都没有，唯有圣人大能可窥其本源。

可他身边这位长青仙宗的国师，竟然轻描淡写说要再造一尊！

这早已不是寻常的伐天逆命，这是要挣脱天道桎梏，取而代之，重塑三界万古格局！

嬴政心脏猛地一沉，近乎骤停，两千年仙途修行铸就的稳固道心，在这一刻险些直接崩碎。

他素来自负，坐拥仙秦基业，麾下铁军万千，一心想要推翻天庭玉帝统治，执掌三界权柄，自认野心冠绝古今。

可此刻与顾长青一比，他那点颠覆天庭的宏图壮志，简直幼稚得如同孩童戏耍。

他人盯着的是凌霄宝殿的帝位，顾长青盯着的，是执掌万物的天道本源！

“国师……此言……当真？”

嬴政嗓音微微发颤，极致的震惊让这位千古帝王的语调都失了平稳。

“自然当真。”

顾长青淡淡瞥了他一眼，语气随意，“怎么，你觉得很难？”

嬴政一时语塞，胸中千言万语尽数堵在喉头。

不是很难，是荒诞到极致，是亘古未有、闻所未闻的逆天之举！

他身后，王贲、蒙恬等一众仙秦名将尽数僵在原地，双目圆瞪，满脸呆滞。

他们追随嬴政征战万古，见惯了九天仙战、神魔厮杀，心志早已坚如磐石，可今日听闻这番话，依旧如同听闻凡人要徒手摘星、凡人要再造苍天，彻底超出了他们的认知范畴。

就在全场死寂、众生震怖之际！

轰隆——！

九天苍穹骤然炸开无尽紫电，滚滚雷云覆盖万里长空，恐怖至极的天道神威镇压四野，连天地灵气都瞬间凝滞！

一道巍峨至极的身影，自九重雷海深处踏步破空而来。

朱红通天神袍绣满雷霆道纹，猎猎作响，震慑诸天；额上竖瞳开合之间，紫金色天道神光横扫八荒，每一缕气息都代表着天庭至高权柄，正是执掌九天雷部、司赏善罚恶、镇三界秩序的天庭第一正神——商朝太师，闻仲！

三界皆知，闻仲乃是封神大劫以身殉商、忠烈封神的无上天尊，坐镇天庭三千年，位高权重、神威盖世，连玉帝见之都需礼让三分，是诸天公认的老牌顶尖大能！

但无人知晓这盖世秘辛——威震九天的雷部天尊闻仲，并非散修得道，而是万古隐世道统长青仙宗的第五代宗主！

长青仙宗传承万古，代代皆有逆天大能出世，顾长青便是宗门绵延至今的第二十代现任宗主。

论辈分，闻仲是货真价实的宗门先辈、上古祖师，是顾长青的往届前辈！

昔日，闻仲少年入道，拜入长青仙宗，承宗门完整道统，修成无上雷霆道身，执掌宗门掌教之位，守山门、传道统，铸就一代盛世。

后为红尘历劫、磨砺道心，方才入世辅佐商汤，最终大劫封神，位列天庭雷部正神。

纵使登天封神、身居高位，纵使时隔十五代传承、岁月流逝千载，闻仲从未忘却宗门本源，心底始终恪守长青门规，铭记先辈道统。

今日人间天地剧变，明月崩碎，他于九天雷府之中，骤然感应到世间传来熟悉至极、凌驾万道的宗门本源气息，更听闻那句石破天惊的“重炼封神榜”！

一瞬间，千年道心剧烈震荡，他不顾天庭天规束缚，直接撕裂九重虚空，跨界降临人间！

漫天雷云翻腾不息，无尽雷光环绕其身，这位屹立三界顶端、素来冷面威严、心如磐石的雷部天尊，在看清云层中央那道白衣绝尘的年轻身影时，周身无上神威瞬间收敛殆尽。

整片天地，骤然死寂！

嬴政瞳孔剧缩，呼吸骤停！

王贲、蒙恬等仙秦将领浑身僵硬，大脑一片空白！

老天师双目圆瞪，身躯剧烈颤抖，脸上写满了毕生未见的惊骇！

他们所有人都清楚闻仲的分量！

那是三千年封神天尊、九天雷部主宰，是足以碾压世间一切仙神的顶级大能！

可此刻，这位高高在上、俯瞰三界的无上正神，双脚落地的刹那，竟微微躬身，姿态恭敬到了极致！

无人不懵，无人不震！

只见闻仲垂首敛神，语气庄重肃穆，带着后辈对现任宗主的极致尊崇，朗声道：“晚辈闻仲，拜见二十代宗主！”

一声拜见，震碎所有人的认知！

威震九天的第五代长青祖师、天庭雷部天尊，竟然是眼前这位年轻宗主的晚辈！

"Then why can't there be a second copy?"

"Chanjiao and Tianting can create a list of gods."

"I, the Evergreen Immortal Sect, can naturally make one again."

Gu Changqing said these words as casually as if he was saying, "Should we eat rice or noodles for dinner today?"

But when heard in the ears of others, it is no less than the first thunder that pierced the Hongmeng when the chaos first opened, shocking people's hearts and minds, and trembling in the Taoist heart!

Ying Zheng, the emperor who conquered the world, conquered the eight wastelands, and had Mount Tai collapse in front of him without changing his expression, his pupils suddenly shrank at this moment, extreme shock surged in his dark eyes, and the blood on his face was slightly stagnant, full of disbelief.

Refining...

List of gods?

What a shocking joke!

No one in the three realms knows the weight of the God List!

That is the treasure of the way of heaven passed down by Taoist ancestor Hongjun. It is the core magic weapon used by the saints to establish the order of the three realms after the end of the Great Tribulation of the Gods. It is in charge of the 365 righteous gods of Zhoutian, regulating wind and rain, controlling mountains and rivers, controlling reincarnation, and stabilizing the universe. It is the most vivid and core embodiment of the rules of the way of heaven in the world!

This thing has long been bound to the way of heaven, it is completely natural, and it will last forever.

Not to mention refining and re-creating, the ordinary Daluo Jinxian is not qualified to touch even a trace of its charm. Only the saint can have a glimpse of its origin.

But the national master of the Evergreen Immortal Sect next to him actually said lightly that he wanted to build another one!

This is no longer an ordinary act of defying heaven and defying fate. This is to break away from the shackles of heaven, replace it, and reshape the eternal pattern of the Three Realms!

Ying Zheng's heart suddenly sank, almost to a sudden stop. The solid Taoist heart forged by two thousand years of spiritual practice almost collapsed at this moment.

He has always been arrogant, sitting on the foundation of Xian Qin, with thousands of iron troops under his command. He wants to overthrow the rule of the Jade Emperor of Heaven and take charge of the power of the three realms. He considers himself to be the most ambitious in ancient and modern times.

But now compared with Gu Changqing, his grand ambition to subvert the heaven is as childish as a child's play.

What others are staring at is the throne of the Lingxiao Palace, but what Gu Changqing is staring at is the origin of heaven that controls all things!

"National Master...is this statement...serious?"

Ying Zheng's voice trembled slightly, and the extreme shock caused the eternal emperor's tone to lose its balance.

"Of course it's true."

Gu Changqing glanced at him lightly and said in a casual tone, "Why, do you find it difficult?"

Ying Zheng was speechless for a moment, and all the words in his chest were stuck in his throat.

It's not that difficult, it's absurd to the extreme, and it's an unprecedented and unheard-of act that defies heaven!

Behind him, Wang Ben, Meng Tian and other famous Xian Qin generals were all frozen in place, their eyes widened and their faces dull.

They have followed Ying Zheng for eternity and have been used to seeing the Nine Heavens fighting and fighting between gods and demons. Their minds have long been as solid as a rock. But hearing these words today is still like hearing that mortals want to reach for stars with bare hands and mortals want to recreate the sky. It is completely beyond their cognitive scope.

Just when the whole place was dead silent and everyone was in shock!

Boom——!

The nine-sky sky suddenly exploded with endless purple lightning, rolling thunderclouds covered the sky for thousands of miles, and the terrifying divine power of heaven suppressed the surrounding areas, and even the spiritual energy of heaven and earth stagnated instantly!

A towering figure stepped through the sky from the depths of the Nine Layers of Thunder Sea.

The crimson sky-reaching god's robe is embroidered with thunder patterns, which makes a hunting sound, shocking the heavens; between the opening and closing of the vertical pupils on the forehead, the purple-gold heavenly light sweeps across the wilderness. Every breath represents the supreme authority of heaven. It is the most righteous god in heaven who is in charge of the Nine Heavens Thunder Department, rewards good and punishes evil, and maintains order in the three realms - Grand Master of the Shang Dynasty, Wen Zhong!

Everyone in the three worlds knows that Wen Zhongnai is the Supreme Heavenly Lord who sacrificed his life for business during the Great Tribulation of the Gods and was loyal to the Gods. He has been in the Heavenly Court for three thousand years. His position is so powerful and powerful that even the Jade Emperor has to show courtesy to him. He is recognized by all the heavens as an old and top power!

But no one knows this unparalleled secret - Wen Zhong, the powerful Lei Bu Tianzun, is not a casual cultivator, but the fifth generation leader of the everlasting Taoist lineage of the Evergreen Immortal Sect!

The Evergreen Immortal Sect has been passed down for eternity, and generations of powerful men have been born. Gu Changqing is the current leader of the twentieth generation of the sect that continues to this day.

In terms of seniority, Wen Zhong is a genuine sect ancestor and ancient ancestor, and Gu Changqing's predecessor!

In the past, Wen Zhong entered Taoism as a young man, worshiped the Evergreen Immortal Sect, inherited the complete Taoist tradition of the sect, cultivated the Supreme Thunder Taoist body, took the position of the sect's leader, guarded the sect, passed down the Taoist tradition, and created a prosperous era.

Later, he went through many tribulations in the world of mortals to sharpen his Taoist mind, and then came into the world to assist Shang Tang. In the end, he became a god during the great tribulation and became the chief god of the thunder department in heaven.

Even though he became a god and held a high position, even after fifteen generations of inheritance and thousands of years passed by, Wen Zhong never forgot the origin of the sect, and always abided by the rules of the Evergreen sect and kept in mind the traditions of his ancestors.

Today, the world was undergoing drastic changes, and the bright moon was shattered. In the Nine Heavens Thunder Mansion, he suddenly sensed the extremely familiar aura of the sect's origin that transcended all realms. He even heard the earth-shattering words "Refining the God List"!

In an instant, the thousand-year-old Taoist heart shook violently. He ignored the constraints of the heavenly rules and directly tore through the nine layers of void, crossing the boundary and descending to the human world!

The sky was filled with thunderclouds, and endless thunder light surrounded him. Standing at the top of the Three Realms, the Leibu Tianzun, who had always had a cold face and a heart as solid as a rock, when he saw clearly the young figure in white clothes in the center of the clouds, the supreme divine power in his body was instantly restrained.

The whole world suddenly became silent!

Ying Zheng's pupils shrank sharply and his breathing stopped suddenly!

Wang Ben, Meng Tian and other Xian Qin generals were stiff and their minds were blank!

The old Heavenly Master's eyes widened, his body trembled violently, and his face was filled with horror that he had never seen in his life!

All of them knew the weight of Wen Zhong!

That is the three-thousand-year-old God-confessed Heavenly Lord and the Lord of the Nine Heavens Thunder Department. It is a top power that can crush all the immortals and gods in the world!

But at this moment, the Supreme God, who was high above and overlooking the three realms, bowed slightly when his feet landed on the ground, his posture was extremely respectful!

No one is confused and no one is shocked!

I saw Wen Zhong lowering his head and concentrating, his tone was solemn and solemn, and with the ultimate respect of the younger generation for the current sect master, he said loudly: "Junior Wen Zhong, pay homage to the 20th generation sect master!"

A greeting shook everyone's consciousness!

The fifth-generation Patriarch Evergreen, who is so powerful in the Nine Heavens, and the Heavenly Lord of the Thunder Department, is actually the junior of the young sect leader in front of him!
